D: A recent graduate becomes the host of an alien scarab and his whole family gets dragged in.
P: Serve the mains when the Reyes family sits down to dinner.
S: corn husk parcels of masa and shredded pork in guajillo, steamed 90 minutes, an old family recipe

Masa spread on corn husks, filled with pork in red chilli sauce, steamed 90 minutes. Simmer 800g pork shoulder in water with onion and garlic for 2 hours, then shred. Blend 4 soaked guajillo chillies with 2 garlic cloves, cumin and 250ml of the cooking liquid and stir through the pork. Soak 16 corn husks in hot water for 30 minutes. Beat 150g lard or butter until fluffy, then beat in 400g masa harina, 2 tsp baking powder, salt and 500ml warm stock. Spread on the husks, add pork, fold up and steam standing for 90 minutes.
Charred corn with lime mayo, crumbled feta and chilli flakes
Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with mayo and lime, rolled in crumbled feta and dusted with chilli.
Chunky avocado, lime, jalapeño and coriander with hot chilli-salted tortilla chips

Milagro makes it chunky and roasts everyone while she does. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges, toss in 3 tbsp oil and bake 10 to 12 minutes until crisp, then dust with Tajín. Mash 4 avocados roughly with the juice of 2 limes and salt, leaving big chunks. Fold through half a finely diced white onion, 2 diced tomatoes, a chopped jalapeño and a handful of coriander. Serve with the warm totopos.
M: Pork and hominy soup with guajillo chilli

Red chilli pork and hominy soup simmered until tender, topped with crunchy cabbage, radish, dried oregano and a big squeeze of lime. Simmer 1kg pork shoulder pieces in 2L water with onion and garlic for 2 hours. Blend 4 soaked dried guajillo chillies with garlic and stir in with 800g tinned hominy and simmer 30 minutes. Serve with shredded cabbage, sliced radish, oregano and lime.
skirt steak in lime, orange and garlic, grilled and sliced into tortillas, for Jaime's homecoming

Skirt steak marinated in lime, garlic and orange, grilled and sliced into tacos with salsa. Marinate 800g skirt steak for 2 hours with the juice of 1 orange and 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, a handful of chopped coriander and 2 tbsp oil. Grill over very high heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice thinly across the grain. Mix 3 chopped tomatoes, half a diced white onion, 1 chopped jalapeño, coriander and lime for salsa. Serve in 12 warm corn tortillas with salsa and lime wedges.
W: Soft yeast buns with a sweet cocoa crumb topping
Sweet yeasted buns topped with a sugar shell crust, baked at 180C for 20 minutes.
K: Chilled rice milk drink with cinnamon, sugar and milk
Rice soaked with cinnamon overnight, blended with milk and sugar, strained and served over ice.

Simmer the stock with the onion and half the garlic.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil until browned at the edges.
Blend the chillies with the rest of the garlic, stir into the pot with the mushrooms and hominy and simmer.
Shred the cabbage and slice the radishes.

s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs over high heat until charred all over. Brush with mayonnaise mixed with lime juice. Roll in crumbled feta and sprinkle with chilli flakes. Serve hot with lime wedges for squeezing over at the table.

s.note: Chunky avocado, lime, jalapeño and coriander with hot chilli-salted tortilla chips
s.how: Heat the oven to 200°C. Cut the tortillas into wedges, toss in the oil and bake 10 to 12 minutes until crisp. Dust with the Tajín. Roughly mash the avocados with the lime juice and a pinch of salt, leaving big chunks. Fold through the onion, tomato, jalapeño and chopped coriander. m.note: Pork and hominy soup with guajillo chilli
m.how: Simmer 1kg pork shoulder pieces in 2L water with onion and garlic for 2 hours. Blend 4 soaked dried guajillo chillies with garlic and stir in with 800g tinned hominy and simmer 30 minutes. Serve with shredded cabbage, sliced radish, oregano and lime.

w.note: Soft yeast buns with a sweet cocoa crumb topping
w.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, 80g sugar, 2 eggs, 80g butter and warm milk into a soft dough and prove an hour. Shape into buns. Mix flour, sugar, butter and a little cocoa into a paste, press a round on each and score. Prove again and bake at 180C for 20 minutes.

d.note: Chilled rice milk drink with cinnamon, sugar and milk
d.how: Soak 200g long grain rice and 2 cinnamon sticks in 1L water overnight. Blend until smooth, then strain through a fine cloth. Stir in 100g sugar and 250ml milk. Chill and pour over ice with a pinch of cinnamon on top.
